title: What Moving Walkway Cities Is
definition: Moving Walkway Cities: cities where walkways do the walking.
description:
Moving Walkway Cities — Signature Edition: cities where walkways do the walking. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature city hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: walkway grids rethought, city logistics rebuilt, speed zoning reimagined for the century ahead. This edition mirrors the public database record for record — concept, components, milestones, demos, drills, alliance, roadmap — but every entry is the Signature take: bolder timelines, integrated systems thinking, and the energy use ambition that defines the Signature line.

t: The Signature Vision: Moving Walkway Cities
title: The Signature Vision: Moving Walkway Cities
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Moving Walkway Cities.
description:
The Signature vision of Moving Walkway Cities does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature city hulls program, charter one: master walkway grids at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale city logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate speed zoning systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Moving Walkway Cities becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

t: 2032 — First certified city hulls service opens: walkway grids propulsi
title: 2032 — First certified city hulls service opens: walkway grids propulsi
definition: 2032 milestone on the Moving Walkway Cities roadmap.
description:
First certified city hulls service opens: walkway grids propulsion carrying paying passengers on city logistics guideways.

What must be true first: the walkway grids results have to replicate outside the lab, city logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and speed zoning operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed walkway grids demonstrations, city logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting speed zoning uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Moving Walkway Cities
definition: Estimates Moving Walkway Cities readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Moving Walkway Cities components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a city hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Moving Walkway Cities Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Moving Walkway Cities operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Moving Walkway Cities installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 86455 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where walkway grids monitoring, city logistics redundancy, or speed zoning maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Moving Walkway Cities Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Moving Walkway Cities: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Moving Walkway Cities — cities where walkways do the walking.

Phase 1 — Prove (walkway grids): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (city logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (speed zoning): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (energy use): city hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and urban-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
